## Professional Summary

Data analyst with three years of combined analytics, applied research, and direct service experience supporting low-income families and economically vulnerable households. Two promotions in two years at the Child Poverty Action Lab. Strong in SQL, Databricks, statistical modeling, and quasi-experimental design. Uniquely positioned to provide insight into how real users decide and save.

## Analytics Experience

### Data Analyst — Child Poverty Action Lab (CPAL) {.unnumbered}

```{=typst}
#text(size: 9.5pt, fill: rgb("#6E6A55"), style: "italic")[Dallas, TX  ·  May 2024 – Present]
```

- Redesigned a financial analytics system modeling revenue variation across service type, delivery channel, and payer mix, improving visibility across approximately \$1.08M annually in managed cash flows and supporting operational and strategic decision-making for finance teams.
- Built and maintained stakeholder-facing dashboards and analytical applications across six program areas, integrating multi-source datasets into real-time decision tools that reduced manual reporting overhead by 8–10 hours per week and improved cross-functional access to actionable insights.
- Designed a probabilistic record linkage and evaluation pipeline analyzing how housing instability relates to long-term student outcomes, applying matched-sampling methods and ordinal logistic regression to support intervention-focused decision-making.
- Developed scalable Databricks data pipelines with API integrations, schema design, and historical change tracking, creating clean and reliable datasets for downstream analytics, reporting, and operational use cases.
- Designed KPI-driven dashboards and analytical frameworks to monitor program performance, surface emerging trends, and support data-informed prioritization for public-sector partners.
- Developed predictive spatial risk models identifying environmental patterns associated with violent crime risk and partnered with operational stakeholders to translate analytical findings into targeted intervention strategies and resource allocation decisions.

## Skills

**Programming & Data** — SQL, R, Python, Databricks (Spark), API integration, ETL/pipeline development, schema design.

**Analytics & Experimentation** — Quasi-experimental design, matched sampling, causal inference, GLMs, panel/longitudinal analysis, cohort and retention analysis, statistical diagnostics, feature engineering, clustering, PCA.

**Visualization** — Shiny, ggplot2, Plotly, Highcharter, Mapbox, Maplibre. Currently building proficiency in Tableau and Amplitude.

**Decision Support** — Stakeholder-facing analytical applications, KPI dashboarding, decision systems, behavioral analysis, program evaluation, spatial analysis, survey research.
